verdict.rationale: LlamaParse is API-first: docs show every core capability (Parse, Extract, Classify, Split, Index) accessible via Python/TS/Go/Java SDKs, CLI, and REST API, with a live keyless OpenAPI spec confirmed by probe, and the UI is described as just one of several equivalent entry points (drag-and-drop mirrors the same extraction config used via API). missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation that every UI-only setting (e.g., visual review tools) has a documented API equivalent, and explicit statement that no UI feature is API-exclusive.
